RECONSTRUCTED TEXT — Open Library search-inside, 2026-09-06
===========================================================
THE CANADIAN KEY BUSINESS DIRECTORY (Dun & Bradstreet Canada) — the Y.M.C.A. de Montréal entry
and its Kamp Kanawana division line, 1993–2001.

NOT A SCAN. Every volume below is lending-restricted on the Internet Archive; none has been
read. The text is assembled from overlapping twelve-word windows returned by
https://openlibrary.org/search/inside.json (contract at f_4933). Page images are blocked: see
the ACCESS FAILURE at the end.

This file exists because p_430's group 2 named four of these volumes and attached a standing
caution — that officer names visible beside the Kanawana line belong to whatever entry the page
sets next to them, and that adjacency in a twelve-word window is not attribution. THE CAUTION
WAS RIGHT AND IS NOW RESOLVED BY EVIDENCE RATHER THAN BY LEAVING THE NAMES ALONE. What follows
records both the entry and the reasoning.


1. WHICH VOLUMES NAME THE CAMP
------------------------------
The query "Kamp Kanawana" returns 13 items across the whole corpus. Four are Canadian Key
Business Directories:

  canadiankeybusin1994unse   leaf 1598
  canadiankeybusin1997unse   leaf 1288
  canadiankeybusin1999unse   leaf 1148
  canadiankeybusin2000unse   leaf 1154

A second query, "849-5331 Emp", finds the SAME association entry — same address, same telephone
— in five more volumes that do NOT name the camp:

  canadiankeybusin1993unse        leaf 1568
  canadiankeybusin1995unse        leaf 1216
  canadiankeybusin1998unse_j8t3   leaf 1158
  canadiankeybusin2001unse        leaf 1164
  canadiankeybusin0000unse_m8l5   leaf 1246   (undated in the catalogue)

DO NOT READ THE ON-OFF PATTERN AS HISTORY. 1994, 1997, 1999 and 2000 carrying the division line
while 1993, 1995, 1998 and 2001 do not is far likelier to be OCR quality or Dun & Bradstreet's
own rotating level of detail than anything that happened at the camp. It is recorded because it
is what the index returns, not because it means anything.


2. THE ENTRY, WALKED FROM ITS OWN HEADING
-----------------------------------------
1999 volume, leaf 1148, walked forward from the D-U-N-S number that opens the entry to the
D-U-N-S number that opens the next one:

    "... D-U-N-S 20-765-0813 (HQ) Y M C A de Montreal Kamp Kanawana D[i]v Of 1441 rue Drummond.
    Montreal. PQ H3G 1W3 Tel 5 14-849-5331 Emp Here 55 Emp Total 1,750 Sales 52,600.000 [Year]
    Started 1857 SIC 8399 Social Services. M. Micheal Novak / Jacques Luys / Nina Caputo / Paul
    Dunne — Pres, conseil d'admin / Vice-president / Secretaire-tresorier / Tresorier
    D-U-N-S [next entry] ..."

("Dtv Of" is the OCR; "Div Of" is what the other three volumes give in the same position.
"52,600.000" is the OCR's decimal point for a comma. The slashes are supplied: see §4.)

The 1994, 1997 and 2000 volumes give the same entry with the same D-U-N-S and telephone. The
1994 volume prints the address as "1441 Drummond Rue"; 1997, 1999 and 2000 print "1441 rue
Drummond". The 1998 volume's window reads "... Emp Here 55 Sales 52,600,000 SIC 8399 Social
Services M. Micheal Novak Jacques Luys Nina Caputo Paul Dunne Emp Total 1,750 Year Started
1 857 ...", i.e. the same four names in the same order a year earlier.

FIGURES BY VOLUME, as returned:
  1993   Emp Here 50   Emp Total 1,780   Sales 21,160,...
  1995   Emp Here 69   Emp Total 1,750   Sales 52,600,...
  1997   Emp Here 69   Emp Total 1,750   Sales 52,600,000
  1998   Emp Here 55                     Sales 52,600,000
  1999   Emp Here 55   Emp Total 1,750   Sales 52,600,000
  2000   Emp Here 20                     Sales 36,100,000
  2001   Emp Here 20                     Sales 36,100,000
  m8l5   Emp Here 69                     Sales 52,600,000

A sales figure repeated unchanged across 1995, 1997, 1998 and 1999 and then replaced wholesale
is a directory's estimate being carried forward and then revised. It is not an annual series and
must not be read as one.


3. WHOSE FIGURES ARE THESE? — THE CONTROL
-----------------------------------------
The question the caution raises is whether "Emp Here 55" counts the camp's staff or the
association's downtown office. It is settled by the D-U-N-S number rather than by the layout.
The query "20-765-0813" returns 24 hits, in Dun & Bradstreet cross-reference sections of much
older volumes, and every one of them reads:

    D-U-N-S 20-765-0813   YOUNG MENS CHRISTIAN ASSOC MTL   1441 Rue Drummond
    D-U-N-S 20-765-0813   YOUNG MENS CHRISTIAN ASS MTL     1441 Drummond
    D-U-N-S 20-765-0813 HQ  YOUNG MENS CHRISTIAN ASSOC MTL 1441 ...

So 20-765-0813 is the ASSOCIATION's number, not the camp's, and the camp had none of its own.
"Emp Here", "Emp Total" and "Sales" belong to that record. They are figures for the Young Men's
Christian Association of Montreal at 1441 Drummond, and NOT a headcount for Kanawana. Anyone
tempted by "Emp Here 55" as a camp staff figure — it is in the right range, and David Leduc's
own account gives 75 — should stop here.

The same 24-hit query is a demonstration of the caution in the other direction. Names appearing
immediately BEFORE the D-U-N-S line — "Michael Goldgrub Pr Emp 320", "William A Young Pr Emp
200", "MR MAURICE NAYEY Dir", "MR JOHN YOUNG PRES", "H Kosansky Exec Di" — belong to the
PRECEDING entry, which the line-of-business words give away ("clothing", "fd"). None of them is
a YMCA officer on this evidence and none is recorded as one.


4. THE FOUR NAMES, AND HOW FAR THEY CAN BE TRUSTED
--------------------------------------------------
M. Micheal Novak, Jacques Luys, Nina Caputo and Paul Dunne appear inside the association's own
entry, after its SIC line and before the next D-U-N-S — walked, not adjacent. They are the
association's officers as the 1998 and 1999 directories list them.

The titles print as a separate run: "Pres, conseil d'admin / Vice-president /
Secretaire-tresorier / Tresorier". Four names, four titles, same order, one walked entry. The
pairing in §2 follows from that and from nothing else: the OCR does not preserve column
alignment, the page image is blocked, and "Secretaire-tresorier" followed by "Tresorier" is odd
enough on its own to be worth flagging. THE NAMES ARE THE FINDING; THE PAIRING IS AN INFERENCE
FROM ORDER, and is written that way wherever it is used.

("Micheal" is the directory's spelling and is left uncorrected.)


5. YEAR STARTED 1857
--------------------
The entry gives "Year Started 1857" for the association. The YMCA of Montreal was founded on
25 November 1851 and is the first YMCA in North America — a date this project holds from far
better sources. 1857 is most likely the year of incorporation or of some later act, self-
reported to Dun & Bradstreet at an unknown date. NO CONFLICT IS RAISED: a commercial credit
directory's "Year Started" field is not a competing historical claim, and treating it as one
would put a tertiary form-field against the association's own record.

This is the lending restriction, not the missing-Referer trap (that one returns a 43-byte
transparent GIF under HTTP 200). Without the image, the column alignment in §4 cannot be
checked, and that is the only thing in this file that is not settled.

ROUTES NOT TRIED: an authenticated Internet Archive borrow; a print or microform copy of the
Canadian Key Business Directory at BAnQ or a Montreal business library; Dun & Bradstreet's own
